usage_examples.maltese: Dak il-ħaddiem hu fergħun veru, ma jistax jafdah ħadd.
usage_examples.english: That worker is a real devil, no one can trust him.

usage_examples.maltese: Tħallihx jgħidlek x'tagħmel, dak fergħun li ma jieħu ħsieb ħadd.
usage_examples.english: Don't let him tell you what to do, he is an evil person who cares about no one.

definitions.text_mt: Jimxi bil-mod ħafna

usage_examples.maltese: Il-marid kien għadu jferken wara l-operazzjoni.
usage_examples.english: The patient was still walking very slowly after the operation.

usage_examples.maltese: Ferken sa wasal id-dar għax kien eżawrit wara l-mixja twila.
usage_examples.english: He walked very slowly until he reached home because he was exhausted after the long walk.

definitions.text_mt: Għodda tal-biedja b'snien tal-ħadid uqgħin għall-ġbir tat-tiben

usage_examples.maltese: Il-bidwi uża l-ferkun biex jiġbor it-tiben mill-għalqa.
usage_examples.english: The farmer used the pitchfork to gather the straw from the field.

usage_examples.maltese: Dak il-ferkun qadim għadu mdendel mal-ħajt tal-magħżel.
usage_examples.english: That old pitchfork is still hanging on the wall of the stable.

definitions.text_mt: B'saħħtu u mibni tajjeb
Stabbli u kostanti

usage_examples.maltese: Dak ir-raġel għadu ferm minkejja l-età avvanzata tiegħu.
usage_examples.english: That man is still strong despite his advanced age.

usage_examples.maltese: Ir-relazzjoni tagħhom baqgħet ferma matul is-snin.
usage_examples.english: Their relationship remained steady throughout the years.

usage_examples.maltese: Għandu qalb ferma u ma jitħawwadx faċilment.
usage_examples.english: He has a constant heart and is not easily shaken.

definitions.text_mt: Element kimiku radjuattiv, bin-numru atomiku 100 u s-simbolu Fm

usage_examples.maltese: Il-fermju hu element transuraniku li niskopra fl-1952.
usage_examples.english: Fermium is a transuranic element that was discovered in 1952.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-kimiku Enrico Fermi ta ismu lil dan l-element, il-fermju.
usage_examples.english: The chemist Enrico Fermi gave his name to this element, fermium.

usage_examples.maltese: In-nar fernaq fil-forn il-lejl kollu u saħħan id-dar kollha.
usage_examples.english: The fire blazed in the oven all night and heated the whole house.

usage_examples.maltese: Meta n-nar jifernaq, il-franka titfa' dawl madwarha.
usage_examples.english: When the fire blazes, the hearth casts light all around.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-gvern feraq l-għajnuna lill-familji kollha fil-bżonn.
usage_examples.english: The government distributed the aid to all the families in need.

usage_examples.english: The children cheered their mother with flowers and gifts at Christmas.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-baqra ferħet għoġol sabiħ u b'saħħtu.
usage_examples.english: The cow produced a beautiful and strong calf.

usage_examples.maltese: Is-siġra tal-larinġ ferħet ħafna frott din is-sena.
usage_examples.english: The orange tree yielded a lot of fruit this year.

definitions.text_en: to spread something over a surface
definitions.text_mt: Xerred jew għatta wiċċ b'saff irqiq ta' xi ħaġa
Xerrex, kabbar il-firxa

definitions.text_en: to increase the area of influence of
definitions.text_mt: Kabbar iż-żona ta' influwenza jew kontroll ta' xi ħaġa

usage_examples.maltese: Ferex il-frak fuq il-mejda għall-ikel tal-festa.
usage_examples.english: He spread the tablecloth on the table for the festive meal.

usage_examples.maltese: L-aħbar infirxet malajr fost il-ġirien kollha.
usage_examples.english: The news spread quickly among all the neighbours.

definitions.text_mt: Ferħan u mimli ferħ

usage_examples.maltese: In-nies kienu ferrieħa fil-jum tal-festa tar-raħal.
usage_examples.english: The people were joyous on the day of the village feast.

usage_examples.maltese: Dejjem tara lit-tfal ferrieħa jilgħabu fil-bitħa tal-iskola.
usage_examples.english: You always see the happy children playing in the school playground.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġenituri ferrieħa raw lil binthom tirċievi l-premju.
usage_examples.english: The joyous parents watched their daughter receive the award.

definitions.text_mt: Ferħan u mimli ferħ

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġabra tal-ħbieb kienet ferrieħija u mimlija daħk.
usage_examples.english: The gathering of friends was joyous and full of laughter.

usage_examples.maltese: Kien lejl ferrieħi b'mużika u żfin sal-għabex.
usage_examples.english: It was a happy evening with music and dancing until dusk.

definitions.text_mt: Sistema ta' trasport fuq binarji tal-ħadid
Vettura li tiġri fuq binarji tal-ħadid u ġġorr passiġġieri jew merkanzija

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ferrovija f'Malta ma għadhiex tintuża mill-bidu tas-seklu għoxrin.
usage_examples.english: The railway in Malta has not been in use since the beginning of the twentieth century.

usage_examples.maltese: Ħadt il-ferrovija minn Valletta sa Rabat meta kont żgħir.
usage_examples.english: I took the train from Valletta to Rabat when I was young.

definitions.text_mt: Ħaddiem li jaħdem fuq ferrovija jew fuq is-sistema tal-binarji

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ferrovjier għen lill-passiġġieri jinżlu mill-ferrovija b'mod sigur.
usage_examples.english: The railwayman helped the passengers get off the train safely.

usage_examples.maltese: Missieri kien ferrovjier u ħadem fuq il-linja tal-ferrovija għal ħamsin sena.
usage_examples.english: My father was a railwayman and worked on the railway line for fifty years.

definitions.text_mt: Sentiment ta' ferħ, hena u għaxqa kbira

definitions.text_en: a young animal, especially a kitten
definitions.text_mt: Annimal żgħir, speċjalment qattus żgħir

usage_examples.maltese: Ferħ kbir kien hemm fil-festa tar-raħal meta waslet l-istatwa.
usage_examples.english: Great joy was felt at the village feast when the statue arrived.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-qattusa welldet tliet ferħan sbieħ u b'saħħithom.
usage_examples.english: The cat gave birth to three beautiful and healthy kittens.

usage_examples.maltese: Ma hemmx ferħ akbar minn dak li tara lil uliedek jirnexxu.
usage_examples.english: There is no greater joy than seeing your children succeed.

definitions.text_mt: Stat ta' ferħ u għaxqa kbira

usage_examples.maltese: Kienet ferħa kbira li tara lil uliedha flimkien wara snin twal.
usage_examples.english: It was a great happiness to see her children together after many years.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ħabib tiegħi żżewweġ u kien hemm ferħa u daħk mal-istednin kollha.
usage_examples.english: My friend got married and there was rejoicing and laughter among all the guests.

definitions.text_mt: Mimli ferħ u kuntentizza

usage_examples.maltese: Kien ferħan meta sema' l-aħbar it-tajba dwar il- promozzjoni tiegħu.
usage_examples.english: He was glad when he heard the good news about his promotion.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġenituri ferħana b'suċċess ta' binthom fl-eżamijiet.
usage_examples.english: The parents are happy with their daughter's success in the examinations.

usage_examples.maltese: It-tfal ferħana marru jilgħabu fil-ġnien wara l-iskola.
usage_examples.english: The happy children went to play in the garden after school.

definitions.text_mt: Neħħa l-qoxra iebsa minn ġewż, lewż jew frott ieħor iebes

usage_examples.maltese: Qagħad fesdaq il-lewż għall-kejk tar-ristorant.
usage_examples.english: He sat shelling the almonds for the restaurant cake.

usage_examples.maltese: Fesdqna l-bżieżel kollha qabel ma kilniehom fil-pranzu.
usage_examples.english: We shelled all the peanuts before eating them at dinner.

usage_examples.maltese: Ommi kienet tifesdaq il-qastan fix-xitwa qabel issajjarhom.
usage_examples.english: My mother used to shell the chestnuts in winter before cooking them.

definitions.text_mt: Kellem b'leħen baxx ħafna biex ma jinstemax

usage_examples.maltese: Fesfsetlu xi ħaġa f'widnejh biex ħadd ma jisma'.
usage_examples.english: She whispered something in his ear so that no one would hear.

usage_examples.maltese: Is-serp fesfes meta resaq viċin tal-bejta tiegħu.
usage_examples.english: The snake hissed when he approached its nest.

definitions.text_mt: Ċelebrazzjoni pubblika jew reliġjuża b'solennità

Jum il-qaddis li minnu persuna ġġib isimha

usage_examples.maltese: Il-festa tar-raħal issir f'Settembru b'logħob tan-nar u mużika.
usage_examples.english: The village feast takes place in September with fireworks and music.

usage_examples.maltese: Meta tiġi l-festa ta' Ġwanni f'Diċembru?
usage_examples.english: When is John's name day in December?

usage_examples.maltese: L-istudenti jħobbu l-festi tal-Milied u tal-Għid.
usage_examples.english: The students love the Christmas and Easter holidays.

definitions.text_en: to unstitch, unseam, rip the seam of

Neħħa l-verġinità ta' mara

usage_examples.maltese: Fetaq il-libsa biex ibiddel iż-żipp li kien miksur.
usage_examples.english: He unstitched the dress to change the broken zip.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ħajjata fetqet il-kejl biex terġa' tħitu aħjar.
usage_examples.english: The seamstress unseamed the measurement to sew it again better.

usage_examples.maltese: Fetaħ il-bieb u daħal bil-mod fil-kamra.
usage_examples.english: He opened the door and entered the room quietly.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-president fetaħ il-mużew il-ġdid nhar il-Ħadd.
usage_examples.english: The president inaugurated the new museum on Sunday.

usage_examples.maltese: Fetaħ id-dawl għax kien dalwaqt jidlam.
usage_examples.english: He switched on the light because it was getting dark soon.

usage_examples.maltese: Wara l-maltemp, it-temp fetaħ u ħareġ ix-xemx.
usage_examples.english: After the storm, the weather cleared up and the sun came out.

definitions.text_mt: Qal kliem b' diffikultà, b' ripetizzjoni ta' ħsejjes jew b'leħen imfixkel

usage_examples.maltese: It-tifel kien jiftetfet meta kien nervuż quddiem in-nies.
usage_examples.english: The boy would stutter when he was nervous in front of people.

usage_examples.maltese: Fetfet ftit meta pprova jispjega l-istorja, imma mbagħad reġa' qabad il-kliem.
usage_examples.english: He stuttered a bit when he tried to explain the story, but then he regained his words.
